# Spanda Works

> Spanda Works LLC is a software company in Charleston, South Carolina, founded on June 17, 2026. We build AI products.

## Products

- [Tīrtha](https://tirtha.ai): One API for the models you need, and a router for coding agents that checks each tool call against your schema.
- [RecompOS](https://recompos.app): A consumer GLP-1 body-recomposition app. Tracks medication schedules, doses, and symptoms with structured progress signals, plus an AI coach that guides instead of guessing. Covers GLP-1, TRT, peptides, and longevity protocols.
